headline: Names a post office in Hazlehurst, Mississippi after First Lieutenant Alvin Chester Cockrell, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service building at 130 Caldwell Drive in Hazlehurst, Mississippi, as the "First Lieutenant Alvin Chester Cockrell, Jr. Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 26, 2014.
